dimensions.name: Product Quality
dimensions.residual_limitation: Seven-window natural verification for the unified Decision Story is pending.
dimensions.description: Correct, complete, consistent and usable public research across seven windows.
dimensions.measurement: Product Quality Gate pass rate plus unresolved natural production defects.
dimensions.evidence: AI-DEV-202 deterministically repairs TW historical fallback, evidence consumption and independent no-trade prediction review. Verified score remains unchanged pending a natural four-window lifecycle.

dimensions.name: Decision Explainability
dimensions.residual_limitation: Natural reports have not yet demonstrated all transition and missing-data scenarios.
dimensions.description: Users can understand actions, confidence, outcomes and unavailable states.

dimensions.residual_limitation: The 2026-07-29 TW 07:00 Google Sheets 503 prevented a canonical batch; bounded fallback is implemented but naturally unverified.

Verified score remains unchanged pending natural US/TW lifecycles.

dimensions.name: Evidence Traceability

dimensions.evidence: AI-DEV-202 links TW feature method/period/source, evidence identity, hypothesis identity, prediction identity and review identity through an append-safe verification record.
